query: Give this dataset a durable confidence score my agent can update every time it re-checks it
expected_behavior: Recognizes this needs resumable, per-asset state, not a one-off metadata update
Runs the one-time 'define' setup so the agent.* structured properties and needs-review tag exist
Uses 'write' with an explicit evidence source, hops, and quality rather than inventing a raw confidence number
Explains that the belief resumes from whatever agent.logodds/agent.mass already sit on the asset, instead of resetting to a neutral prior
Reads the written properties back to verify the write actually landed before reporting success
